“No one escapes from you.”

**Enforcer** is an Agility-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Small guns gain a greater stagger chance and increased limb damage.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | Your small guns gain a 15% stagger chance and +75% limb damage. | 00322356 | 
| ★★ | 2 | Your small guns gain a 10% stagger chance and +50% limb damage. | 00322355 | 
| ★ | 1 | Your small guns gain a 5% stagger chance and +25% limb damage. | 00322354 | 

- The effects of Enforcer are calculated per projectile, as opposed to per shot. If multiple projectiles connect to a single limb, stagger is more likely; becoming nearly guaranteed at ranks two and three if used with multi-projectile weapon.
- Before Update 60, the perk worked only with shotguns.
- Before update 59, Enforcer provided 5%/10%/15% stagger chance and 10%/20%/30% chance to cripple a limb for all shotguns.

The perk card design for Enforcer parodies a poster for the 2012 film *Killing Them Softly*, in which Brad Pitt plays a mafia enforcer named Jackie Cogan.
